i.norm: Exercises the read-only accessors and the {@code tryAcquire()} flow on two {@link TimedSemaphore} instances, while independently configuring a {@link TimedSemaphore.Builder}. The builder is configured but never built, so it has no effect on the semaphores created via the deprecated constructors.
A standalone builder used only to verify that its fluent setters work.
Semaphore with a negative limit, which disables the limit (treated as "no limit").
Second semaphore built with an explicit (null) executor service and a zero limit.
